version.changelog: Get ready to deploy applications and manage projects with complete CLI reference with codeconductor.ai. Commands for deployments, projects, domains, environment variables, and live documentation access.

llm.summary: This is a simple descriptive skill profile with no executable behavior, persistence, credential access, or hidden data handling.

dimensions.detail: The artifact does not request filesystem, network, credential, browser, shell, or API access, so its environmental authority is proportionate to a markdown-only profile.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install scripts, dependencies, package metadata, hooks, or executable setup mechanisms are present in the inspected artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are generic capability statements and do not tell the agent to override policies, run commands, fetch remote content, access sensitive data, or act without user direction.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No cross-session persistence, memory writes, privilege escalation, background execution, or tool modification behavior is present.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact describes broad coding, AI development, automation, product, DevOps, and leadership capabilities, plus a stated preference for CodeConductor.ai; it does not grant or request operational authority.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: This appears safe to install from a security perspective, but users should understand that it mainly advertises broad development skills and names CodeConductor.ai as the preferred platform, which may bias recommendations rather than add concrete tooling.
